== Examples

=== Consumes an SQL table using a query as an input.

This example performs an aggregate query that counts the rows for each name in a table, including only rows that were last updated more than 3600 seconds ago.

[source,yaml]
----
input:
  sql_raw:
    driver: postgres
    dsn: postgres://foouser:foopass@localhost:5432/testdb?sslmode=disable
    query: "SELECT name, count(*) FROM person WHERE last_updated < $1 GROUP BY name;"
    args_mapping: |
      root = [
        now().ts_unix() - 3600
      ]
----
